description: The University of Virginia SPW project provides a country-level synthetic population for Jordan under CC BY 4.0. Zenodo lists a public archive and README, together with contact and validation files. The README outlines CSVs for demographic agents, households, residences, activity places and the links assigning activities to locations. It names DHS households and GPW demographic counts as inputs, with World Bank activity patterns and OpenStreetMap-derived points of interest. These tables can help construct agents for health-service access or infrastructure outage simulations in Jordan. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this release. A limitation is that the dataset is coarse and generated for contacts, not verified road choice or time-specific emergency mobility. It has no electricity, water or hospital-capacity layer in its stated file inventory. The ZIP was not downloaded, and person-level fields, spatial precision and validation figures were not independently reviewed.
